_about: Client-neutral colour looks (ffmpeg -vf filter chains), first built on 11 Nov 2026. A client's default look is projects.json 'grade_default'. Apply with bin/grade; compare with scripts/grade.py board. Hooks, text and end cards are never graded.

original.label: Original
original.desc: No grade. Each source keeps its own colour.

warm_film.label: Warm Film
warm_film.desc: Warm mids and highlights, lifted blacks, light grain. Soft and analog.

teal_orange.label: Teal Orange
teal_orange.desc: Cool shadows, warm skin. Punchy, closest to festival footage.

sage.label: Sage
sage.desc: Muted, with a green-sage tint. Calm.

night_moody.label: Night Moody
night_moody.desc: More contrast, deep blue shadows, vignette. Club feel.

mono.label: Mono
mono.desc: Black and white, high contrast, grain. Hides colour mismatch between sources best.
